description: This file defines a sealed class 'CharacterMap' implementing IDictionary<int, ushort>. It manages a map of character codes to glyph indices for OpenType fonts, with methods for setting glyph counts, adding entries, and retrieving mappings. The class is internal and focuses on cmap type 4 and 12, used for character to glyph mapping in fonts.

classes.name: CharacterMap
classes.description: An internal sealed class that implements IDictionary<int, ushort> for managing character to glyph mappings in OpenType fonts.

methods.name: SetGlyphCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of glyphs, used for validation of cmap entries.

methods.name: SetCharacterEntry
methods.description: Sets a glyph index for a specific character code if valid.

methods.name: GetGlyphPointer
methods.description: Retrieves the glyph index for a given character code.
